hypothesis.cheapest_refuting_observation: One aligned read at `python tools/gdl/fnasm.py game/ui/btext StringTextWidthSub 0x88:0xa8 --diff` after any mask probe: if `@0x9c` still emits the clrlwi ahead of `addi r23,r1,108`, that mask position did not reach the decision and the remaining slot is scheduler-internal. Pair it with `python tools/gdl/slotdiff.py game/ui/btext StringTextWidthSub`, because the frame is bought by a declaration-count balance and any probe that adds or removes a declaration re-opens it.

What has NOT been checked is the mask written inside the loop body after the first buffer use, and nothing this pass touched shape B's zero seed successfully.
hypothesis.statement: The residual is TWO shapes, each appearing twice, and this pass proves which one source can still reach. SHAPE A, the color mask against the line-buffer base: in the idx>=0 arm the target emits `@0x9c addi r23,r1,108` then `@0xa0 clrlwi r28,r31,24` while ours emits the same two words transposed, the color mask at 0x9c and `addi r23,r1,108` at 0xa0; in the else arm the target emits `@0x108 addi r25,r1,36`, `@0x10c clrlwi r31,r31,24`, `@0x110 addi r23,r3,0 @gTextWorkBuf(ADDR16_LO)` while ours emits the clrlwi first at 0x108. SHAPE B, the zero seed against the call: the target emits `@0x84 li r25,0` BEFORE `@0x88 add r3,r6,r0` and `@0x8c bl FixMLineText`, and `@0x144 li r22,0` before `@0x148 add r3,r6,r0` and `@0x14c bl FixMLineText`, while ours emits both seeds AFTER their call, at 0x8c and 0x14c. SHAPE A is source-reachable and moved this pass: masking inside the inlined helper (PROBE 3) put the else-arm clrlwi in the target's slot relative to `@0x108 addi r25,r1,36` and only transposed it against the gTextWorkBuf LO addi instead - i.e. the mask can be walked one slot at a time by moving where it is written. The next lane's step 1 is to walk it ONE MORE SLOT: PROBE 3 masked at the top of the helper body, so the untried position is inside the loop, immediately after `ls = buf[j];`, which is the first statement that uses the buffer base and therefore the only place the mask can be written that is definitely AFTER the base materialisation. SHAPE B is the live-zero family (`s32 maxw = 0;`, whose zero also seeds the inlined helper's `j` and `max` at `@0x94` and `@0x98` by copy) and splitting the declaration from its initializer (PROBE 4) rearranged the object without moving it, so shape B should be screened against claim.law.live-zero-copy-vs-remat-is-allocator-not-source.20260831.v1 before another build is spent on it.
